book.name: Markus
book.title: Cau amsǝban a nê mala MARKUS

content: Kànìgìr amur gau doɓala
Yesu ɗeki Kapanahum, wari a bu-nzali Yahudi, a nkaring Mùr Jodan. Ɓwabunda yi ram ɗǝm a bani à kàrì aɓalǝu, pǝlǝa kania wia gìr kǝla mǝnana pàkkiyi ka.
Aɓea amǝ Farisi yiu à yì kārǝki nǝ ɗiban ama, <<Nggurcau eare ama ɓǝ̀ ɓwa ɓǝ̀ pǝr māmí le?>>
Yesu pǝlǝa earia wia nǝ ɗiban ama,

content.text: <<Mana ɗe Musa bang aɓa nggurcau amur gau-doɓala?>>

content: À nyesǝi wi ama, <<Musa eare ama, ɓǝ̀ ɓwa ɓǝ̀ gilǝî ɓwama takada gau doɓala, sǝ ɓǝ̀ tasǝ takwari ɓǝ̀ o.>>
Yesu nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Nda ace murcandǝa ma'wun sǝ Musa gilǝa wun mǝnia yì nggurcau ka.
Sǝ mǝno ka nda njar mala Ɓakuli ɗang. A tita pusǝ ɓanza ka, <Ɓakuli pusǝ ɓwapǝndǝa, ɓwabura andǝ ɓwama,> kǝla mana Malǝmce na ka.
<Ace mani ka, ɓwabura nǝ̀ nying tárrí andǝ ngge, nǝ̀ yia lanzǝa arǝ māmí.
Yia ɓari ka à dumǝna nggūrǝu mǝ'mwashati.> À pa ɗǝm ɓari ɗàng, à nda mwashat.
Ace mani ka, gìr mǝnana Ɓakuli kpapi ka, ɓwa ɓǝ̀ kǝa gauwi ɗàng.>>

content: Lang à nyarǝna a ɓala ka, alaggana mala Yesu ɗì amur mǝnia yì cau ka.
Pǝlǝa nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Ɓǝ̀ koyana sǝ pǝr māmí sǝ al ɓe ɓwama ka, nda rǝ pakki ɓwama mǝdǝmbe cauɓikea mala nongnǝban a nza nǝ doɓala nǝ ɓaria ɓwama.
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ ɓwama nda gbal nying burí, sǝ kya al ɓe ɓwabura ka, nda rǝ pak cauɓikea mala nongnǝban a nza nǝ doɓala.>>

content: Yesu tsǝki amuna bu
Aɓea ɓwana yiu nǝ amuna aban Yesu ɓǝ̀ tsǝkia bu, pǝlǝa alaggana male lo à sà a rǝia.
Lang Yesu nǝ̀ sǝn mǝnia yì gìr ka, bumi lúllô arǝ alaggana male. Pǝlǝa nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Wu ɗekia amuna ɓǝa yiu abanam, wu kǝa pǝria ɗang. Acemǝnana domurǝm mala Ɓakuli ka, nda ace aɓwana mǝnana à nda kǝla amǝnia yia amuna ka.
Ən nggǝ bangga wun ɓafo, ɓwa mǝnana pà nǝ̀ ak domurǝm mala Ɓakuli kǝla muna mǝkyauwe raka, pà nǝ̀ kútí kam ɗàng.>>

content: Pǝlǝa twal amuna a kikili, sǝ tsǝk buì a ɓamur koyan ateà ka, sǝ tsǝkia wia bu.
Lagga mǝkume
Lang Yesu longŋǝna nǝ̀ o ka, ɓeɓwa ɓangŋa atè kya kū`ndǝó a ɓadǝmbi, sǝ zǝmbi wi ama, <<Malǝm mǝɓoarne, mana gir ni mǝ nǝ pa sǝ mǝ nǝ kum yilǝmu mǝnana málá male pà kàm raka?>>
Yesu ɗì ama,

content.text: <<Palang sǝ a tunǝam ama Malǝm mǝɓoarne? Kǝɓwa pà kàm mǝɓoarne na ɗang, kǝ Ɓakuli na nǝmurǝì ɓǝ̀rɓǝ̀r.
A súrǝ̀ anzongcau mǝnia ka: <Kǝa wal-lú ɗang, kǝa pak cauɓikea nongnǝban a nza nǝ doɓala ɗang, kǝa iun'í ɗang, kǝa na nyir ɗang, kǝa ɓǝmbǝriban ɗang, gusǝlǝ tárró andǝ nggo.> >>

content: Pǝlǝa ɓwabure na ama, <<Malǝm, yàle mǝ nda muna sǝ ǝn bwal amǝnia yì anzongcau ka.>>
Yesu sǝni sǝnban earcearǝu, pǝlǝa ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Gìr mwashat sǝ a ɗwanyi, o, kya mak girkuma mo kat, sǝ wu gakì amǝ'tǝ̀r boale, awu nǝ kum gǝna a kùli. Sǝ wu yiu wu yi kpatam.>>

content: Lang nǝ̀ ok mǝnia yì cau ka, nun nggúr a dǝmbǝi. Pǝlǝ rǝì o nǝ ɓabumkiɗikea, acemǝnana yì ka, ndanǝ kume kǝ̀rkǝ́r.
Yesu pǝlǝ rǝì sǝnban, pǝlǝa ne alaggana male ama,

content.text: <<Amǝkume ka, nǝ kwanbia wia sǝ à nǝ̀ kutio a domurǝm mala Ɓakuli!>>

content: Cau male pakki alaggana male ndali. Pǝlǝa Yesu nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Wun amuna, kutio a domurǝm mala Ɓakuli ka kwano na a gir nì ɗang fa!
Kutio mala mǝkume aɓa domurǝm mala Ɓakuli ka kwano kútì kutio mala kalakadambi a tūli nlerǝman.>>

content: Alaggana ndali kǝ̀rkǝ́r. À ɗiki rǝarǝia ama, <<Sǝ yana ado nǝ̀ au le?>>
Yesu sǝnia kyap-kyap, sǝ na ama,

content.text: <<Ɓǝ̀ mala ɓwapǝndǝa na ka, mǝ gandǝe pà kàm ɗang, sǝama pa anggo aban Ɓakuli ɗang. Aban Ɓakuli ka koman ngga nǝ̀ gandǝ pa.>>

content: Bitǝrus pǝlǝa kasǝi ama, <<Sǝni, sǝm ɗekina koyagir ka, sǝm yiu a kpato!>>
Yesu pǝlǝi wi ama,

content.text: <<Ɓafo na, ǝn nggǝ na wun ngga, ɓǝ̀ ɓwa ɗeki ɓala, ko amǝ'eambi amuna-burana, andǝ amuna-mamǝna, ko nggè ko tárrí, ko amuna, ko aɓaban acem andǝ ce hamnǝ Cau Amsǝban ngga,

nǝ̀ kum tangnakusǝi. A ɓanza mǝnia ka, nǝ̀ kum aɓala, amǝ'eambu aburana andǝ amamǝna, anggeau, amuna, andǝ aɓaban; amǝnana làkkì malea nǝ̀ ká kusǝ gbǝman mala amǝnana ɗekia ka. Nǝ̀ kumia atārǝia andǝ nutanni gbal. Sǝ a ɓanza mǝnana kǝ yiu ka nǝ̀ kum yilǝmu mǝnana málá male pà kàm raka.
Aɓwana pas mǝnana à nda tyang-tyang ado ka, à nǝ̀ nggá būrǝcea, sǝ amǝnana à būrǝcea ado ka, à nǝ̀ nggá duk tyang-tyang.>>

content: Yesu nacau ɗǝm amur lú male

À nda aban o a Urǝshalima ka, Yesu ak dǝmba kǝ ká sǝ alaggana male na atè. Alaggana male ndali kǝ̀rkǝ́r, sǝ acili aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ yiu ateà ka ɓangciu pakkia wia, acemǝnana a Urǝshalima ka, aɓwana nda kam pas mǝnana à ɓinǝmǝsǝì ka. Pǝlǝa Yesu tunǝ alaggana male lum-nong-ɓari a giriban, sǝ banggia wia koyagir mǝnana nǝ̀ nggá kumi ka.
Nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Sǝm ndya sǝm kǝ eauwe aban o a Urǝshalima ka. Muna mala Ɓwa ka à nǝ̀ nggá kúrnà kúró nǝi, a ban agbani pǝris andǝ amǝkani Nggurcau mala Musa. À nǝ̀ kasǝi wi ɓashi lú, sǝ à nǝ̀ tasǝi a bu aɓwana mǝnana amǝ Yahudi na raka.
Yia ka à nǝ̀ oali, à nǝ̀ tapî ntāra arǝì, à nǝ̀ koè, sǝ à nǝ̀ wal-luí. Sǝa ma anzǝm anongŋo tàrú ka nǝ̀ lo nǝ yilǝmu.>>

content: Zǝmba mala Jemis andǝ Yohana
À nǝ̀ nggǝ ká a njar ka, Jemis andǝ Yohana, amuna-burana mala Zabadi, à yiu a baní tù à yì ne wi ama, <<Malǝm, sǝm nggǝ earce ama wu pakka sǝm gìr mǝnana sǝm nǝ̀ zǝmbo wu pak ka!>>
Yesu pǝlǝa ɗia ama,

content.text: <<Mana wu earkiyice mǝ pakka wun?>>

content: À eari wi ama, <<Pwari mǝnana a nǝ do a buno-murǝm mǝɓoarɓwe mò ka, ɓǝ̀ mwashat atà sǝm ɓǝ̀ do a buo mǝlì, sǝ ɓeɓwa ɓǝ̀ do a buo mǝ'nggare aɓa ɓoarɓwa mò.>>
Yesu earia wia ama,

content.text: <<Wu súrǝ̀ gir mǝnana wu zǝmgiyi ka ɗàng. Wun nǝ̀ gandǝ nu aɓa kwap mala tanni mǝnana málá mǝ nǝ nu kàm ngga, ko wun nǝ̀ gandǝ ak batisǝma mala walban lú kǝla mǝnana dumǝnam púp à nǝ̀ wal luem ngga le?>>

content: À pǝlǝa à eare ama, <<Sǝm nǝ̀ gandǝi.>> Yesu nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Ɓafo na wun nǝ̀ nu aɓa kwap mǝnana dupǝnam púp mǝ nǝ nu kàm ngga, sǝ à nǝ̀ pakka wun batisǝma mǝnana dumǝnam púp à nǝ̀ pakkam ngga.
Sǝa ma, pa aɓa buam ɓǝ̀n tsǝk ɓwa ɓǝ̀ do atà buam mǝlì, ko a buam mǝ'nggare ka ɗàng. Ɓakuli gilǝki amǝno yì aban ngga ace aɓwana mǝnana tarkia ka.>>

content: Lang acilia alaggana mana lum nǝ̀ ok gìr mǝno Jemis andǝ Yohana alkite ka, bumia lúllô.
Pǝlǝa Yesu tunǝia à yì ramba, sǝ nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Kǝla mana wu sǝlǝ ka, aɓwana mǝnana à súrǝ̀ia ama à nda ka murǝma, ko à nda ka ɓwana-mǝgule a ɓanza man ngga, à kǝ lǝmdǝ rǝcandǝa amur aɓwana mana à nda aɓatea ka.
Sǝa ma atà wun ngga, pà nǝ̀ pa anggo ɗàng. Ɓwa mǝnana kǝ earce nǝ̀ duk ɓwamǝgule atà wun ngga, dumǝna púp nǝ̀ duk rítǎu mala acilia.
Sǝ ɓwa mǝnana earce ama nǝ̀ duk mǝ dǝmba
ka, dumǝna púp nǝ̀ duk guro mala aɓi kat.
Ko nggearǝ Muna mala Ɓwa ka yiu ace mǝnana nǝ̀ do sǝ ɓǝ̀ aɓwana pakki wi túró ka ɗàng. Yì ka, yiu ace mǝnana nǝ̀ pakki aɓwana túró, sǝ ɓǝ̀ pà yilǝmi ace amsǝ
ɓwabundǝa pas.>>

content: Nte Bartimawus kum sǝnban
Yesu andǝ alaggana male yi bik Jeriko. Lang a nda aban purrì ɓá Jeriko ka, aɓwana pas kana ateà. Ɓè nte nda kam lùllǝì ama Bartimawus, muna mala Timawus, dumǝna a girǝi njargula aban zǝmgi agir.
Lang nǝ̀ ok ama Yesu Ɓwa Nazarat nda kǝ kútí ka, tita loasǝ gi kǝ na ama, <<Yesu, Mǝkà Dauda, sǝn mǝsǝswatǝr mem!>>
Aɓwana pas loarǝì, à pyau wi ɓǝ̀ pwalo. Kara nyare loasǝ gi kàm kpǝm ama, <<Mǝkà Dauda, sǝn mǝsǝswatǝr mem!>>
Lang Yesu oè ka, pǝlǝ rǝì sǝ came, na ama,

content.text: <<Wu tunǝì ɓǝ̀ yiu.>>

content: Pǝlǝa à tunǝì yì nte, à ne wi ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ banɓoaro, lo, nda kǝ tunǝo ka.>>
Kara túr gìrkùmsǝo male anggo, lo pǝrpǝr yiu a ban Yesu.
Yesu ɗì ama,

content.text: <<Mana a earce ama mǝ pakko?>>

content: Nte man pǝlǝa ne wi ama, <<Malǝm, ǝn nggǝ earce sǝnban!>>
Yesu ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Kyane, gūliarǝu mo arǝ Ɓakuli twalǝno ban rǝkwana.>>

content: Àkǝ̀ banì kara sǝnban, pǝlǝa kpata Yesu aban o a njargula.
